_comment: RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge (2018). 30,000 frontal chest X-rays in DICOM format, a subset of NIH ChestX-ray14. Task: detect and localize lung opacities. Annotations were collected from multiple annotator teams + adjudication; the 'Calculated' label group contains the final consensus labels. Source: adjudicated JSON annotation export.

primary_csv._comment: No CSV — annotations come from the adjudicated JSON export. The harmonizer parses the JSON file directly and flattens the 'Calculated' label group into a DataFrame.

patient_id._comment: StudyInstanceUID from the JSON annotations identifies each study/patient.

study_id._comment: One study per patient in this dataset, use StudyInstanceUID.

image_path._comment: Image export uses three-level UID nested directories: <StudyInstanceUID>/<SeriesInstanceUID>/<SOPInstanceUID>.dcm

labels._comment: Three classes from the 'Calculated' label group: Normal (L_o8w, global), No Lung Opacity / Not Normal (L_yd0, global), Lung Opacity (L_v8n, local/bbox). One-hot encoded. 29,684 unique images: Normal=9,790, No Lung Opacity / Not Normal=12,788, Lung Opacity=11,390.

separate_csv._comment: Labels are embedded in the JSON file, not a separate CSV.

uncertain_handling._comment: Calculated labels are final consensus — no uncertain values.

view_position._comment: All images are frontal chest X-rays. View position not available in the JSON; would need DICOM headers.

bboxes._comment: Bounding boxes for Lung Opacity annotations in the Calculated group (L_v8n). Pixel coordinates: data.x, data.y, data.width, data.height on 1024x1024 images. 11,390 bbox annotations across 7,314+ images (some images have multiple boxes, 4,076 images with 2+).
bboxes.column: annotation.data: {x, y, width, height} in JSON

extra_init_params.json_path: Path to the adjudicated JSON export file (pneumonia-challenge-annotations-adjudicated-kaggle_2018.json)
extra_init_params.label_group: Which label group to use. Default 'Calculated' for final consensus. Options: 'Default group', 'QA', 'Team 1', 'Team 2', 'Team 2a', 'Calculated', 'Adjudication'.

custom_preprocessing: Parse adjudicated JSON format instead of CSV. Extract annotations from the 'Calculated' label group. Build per-image rows: one-hot encode the 3 class labels, aggregate bounding boxes per SOPInstanceUID. DICOM images need pixel_array extraction. Calculated label IDs: L_o8w=Normal, L_yd0=No Lung Opacity / Not Normal, L_v8n=Lung Opacity (bbox).
